content.text: {"name": "run_python", "parameters": {"code": "import csv, json; with open(\'CATALOG_CSV\") as c: catalog = csv.DictReader(c); with open(\'VALUES_CSV\") as v: values = csv.DictReader(v); series_id = None; max_power = 0; max_device = None; for row in catalog: if row[\'point_uri\'] in [\'<device1uri>\', \'<device2uri>\', \'<device3uri>\']: series_id = row[\'timeseries_id\']; break; if series_id is None: return submit_answer(abstain=True, needed_streams=\'Chiller02, CondPump01, CondPump02\'); for row in values: if row[\'timeseries_id\'] == series_id and row[\'timestamp\'] == \'2018-10-22T00:00:00\': power = float(row[\'value\']); if power > max_power: max_power = power; max_device = row[\'timeseries_id\']; result = json.dumps({'entity': max_device}); submit_answer(answer={'entity': max_device})"}}
